{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or low (e.g., < 0.33) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive (e.g., > 0.50) to avoid lagged reactions.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment strongly supports upward trend.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) to avoid overfitting to short-term noise.",
    "Correct for overshoot after sharp spikes: if true outcome drops > 15% from forecast peak, adjust next period’s forecast downward by 5–10%.",
    "When sentiment is high (e.g., > 0.67), allow forecast to slightly lag true trend by 1–2 periods to avoid premature overreaction.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., 3+ consecutive underperformance), reduce forecast by 3–5% to align with historical underestimation bias."
  ]
}
